name: AppHomeScreen
title: AppHomeScreen
summary: The composed dot.Bible home screen, built only from App UI parts: app bar with the dot.Bible mark, search, continue-reading card, grouped language rows, mini player and tab bar.
whenToUse: Use as the reference layout for the dot.Bible Home tab and as the pattern for other ISM app home screens.
Copy its order and spacing; swap the content blocks for the app in question.
whenNotToUse: Do not add a hero image or marketing banner above Continue reading.

anatomy.description: Top to bottom inside `.ap-screen`: 1. `.ap-sb` status bar + `.ap-bar` with `.ap-wm` (dot.Bible icon + wordmark), notifications `.ap-tb`, account `.ap-avatar`. 2. Search field `.ap-px` > `.ap-field` ("Search 500+ languages"), opens SearchResults. 3. Continue card `.ap-cont`: `.ap-kicker.ap-kicker-blue`, `.ap-cont-t`, progress `.ap-ring-sm`, Lora preview `.ap-cont-v`, `.ap-cont-acts`. 4. `.ap-res-h` "Your languages" + See all ›, then `.ap-grp` rows with `.ap-lt` tiles and › or `.ap-dl`. 5. Mini player `.ap-mini` with `.ap-mini-line` progress. 6. `.ap-tabbar`, Home active.

variantNotes: First run (no reading yet): replace the continue card with "Start reading" (Genesis 1 or John 1) and keep one primary.
No languages downloaded: rows show `.ap-dl-idle` buttons and sizes.
Nothing playing: drop `.ap-mini`; content scrolls straight under the tab bar.
Dark mode: use `.ap-screen.ap-dark` and `.ap-tabbar.ap-dark`; the mark gets `filter: brightness(0) invert(1)`.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: One Horizon Blue primary on the screen: Continue. Everything else is secondary, ghost or a row.
The dot in the wordmark is Horizon Blue; the icon renders black (inverted on dark).
Downloaded languages show ›; languages not on the phone show the download button, so people see what works offline.
Mini player: `--charcoal-900`, `--radius-md`, 8px above the tab bar, `--gradient-line` progress on top.
Notification and update dots are Horizon Blue, never red.
Keep 16px side margins throughout; cards `--radius-lg`, rows `--radius-md`.

accessibility: Screen title is "Home" for assistive tech even though the wordmark is shown (a visually hidden `h1` or the tab name).
Progress ring and mini-player line have text equivalents ("42 percent read", "2:14 of 5:40").
Reading order follows the visual order; the mini player comes before the tab bar.
All tap targets are 44px or more.
content: Kicker: "Continue reading · BSB"; title is the chapter, preview is the next verse in Lora.
Language rows: English name + native script, then "Bible + audio · Downloaded" or size.
